 C. Ronaldo Al Nassr FC Saudi Pro League Al-Faisaly vs Al Nassr FC Al-Faisaly The Portuguese star continues his march towards 1,000 career goals in official matches.
 Cristiano Ronaldo scored in Al Nassr's 3-1 away win at Al Faysaly in the Saudi Pro League and r eached 982 career goals. The 41-year-old Portuguese star has taken another step towards 1,000 career goals in official matches. With today's goal, CR7 has scored 836 goals for clubs (in 1,109 matches) and 146 for the national team (in 234 matches). 
 Across his club career, Ronaldo has scored 5 for Sporting Lisbon, 145 for Manchester United, 450 for Real Madrid, 101 for Juventus and 135 for Al Nassr. 
 This season, Ronaldo has scored 6 goals for Al Nassr (5 in the Saudi Pro League and 1 in the Asian Champions League). Today, Ronaldo put Al Nassr 2-0 up from a Joao Felix assist. Al Hamdan and Angelo scored the other two goals for the five-time Ballon d'Or winner's side. Bongonda scored for Al Faysaly.
